detail.title: 一种用于玻璃面板及分隔纸的抓取装置
detail.abstract: The utility model provides a grabbing device for glass panels and separation paper, which comprises an installation rack, a transverse slide rail arranged on the installation rack, a glass panel grabbing component and a separation paper grabbing component which are arranged on the transverse slide rail in a sliding way, and a transverse driving mechanism used for driving the glass panel grabbing component and the separation paper grabbing component to move along the transverse slide rail; the relative positions of the glass panel grabbing component and the separating paper grabbing component are fixed. The gripping device for the glass panels and the separation paper provided by the utility model can realize the alternate gripping and output of the glass panels and the separation paper by arranging two gripping components which are fixed in relative positions and can move synchronously; the glass panel and the separating paper are alternately output without a large amount of waiting time, and the whole working efficiency is greatly improved.
